cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
MAX=(1<<62)-1
random.seed(5)
for trial in range(100):
    ev=[{'keys':['A']}]
    received=random.choice([None,0,5,20])
    last=received
    seen=set() if received is None else {received}
    current=0
    epochs={} if received is None else {0:[received,received,1]}
    exp=[]
    for i in range(30):
        pn=random.randrange(0,80)
        ann=random.choice([None,0,1,2,3,4])
        phase=random.randrange(2)
        w=envelope('A',pn,b'\x01',width=4,phase=phase)
        ev.append(datagram(w,(ann,)))
        st=None; epout=None
        if ann is None: st='AUTH'
        else:
            window= ann==current or (current>0 and ann==current-1) or (current<MAX and ann==current+1)
            if not window or (ann&1)!=phase: st='AUTH'
            elif pn in seen: st='DUPLICATE';epout=ann
            else:
                bad=False
                for e,(mn,mx,c) in epochs.items():
                    if e<ann and mx>=pn:bad=True
                    elif e>ann and mn<=pn:bad=True
                if bad:st='KEY_UPDATE_ERROR';epout=ann
                else:
                    st='OK';epout=ann
                    seen.add(pn)
                    if last is None or pn>last:last=pn
                    if ann in epochs:
                        mn,mx,c=epochs[ann];epochs[ann]=[min(mn,pn),max(mx,pn),c+1]
                    else:epochs[ann]=[pn,pn,1]
                    if ann==current+1 and current<MAX:current=ann
        exp.append((st,epout,pn))
    r=run(trace(ev,received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':received},local_cids=('aa','bb')))['traces'][0]
    got=[(p['status'],p['epoch'],p['pn']) for p in r['packets']]
    if got!=exp or r['key_epoch']!=current or r['received']['A']!=last:
        print('MISMATCH trial',trial,'received',received,'current model',current,'out',r['key_epoch'])
        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(got,exp)):
            if a!=b: print('at',j,'got',a,'exp',b)
        print('epochs out',r['epochs'],'model',epochs,'last',r['received']['A'],last)
        break
else: print('all 100 match')
